create_MigrationDropCollection: create a MigrationDropCollection instance to drop a MongoDB collection irreversibly
run_MigrationDropCollection_up: run the up method of MigrationDropCollection to drop a specified MongoDB collection
test_MigrationDropCollection_validate: test the validate method of MigrationDropCollection to check collection existence before dropping
review_MigrationDropCollection_down: review the down method of MigrationDropCollection which raises IrreversibleMigrationError on rollback
build_MigrationDropCollection: build a MongoDB migration using MigrationDropCollection to drop a collection by name and alias
